openwrt_wiki.Einleitung: Wireless-AC router based on QCA IPQ8064 with 32MB flash and 512MB RAM.
Installation Notes: On version 1.0 of this device, OpenWrt can be loaded from the router's standard firmware upgrade page ... Verified 2020/12/19 by Rygle on device version 1.0 from factory software Build 20150610 Rel. 32140 to OpenWrt 19.07.5
On Version 1.1 of this device, the factory default username and password doesn't work. Hence the need to use TFTP to load OpenWrt.

Some units with "v1.1" physical label are recognized in software as "v1.0". Installing OpenWrt by uploading the factory image via the standard firmware upgrade page works for these models. (2022/03 using OpenWrt 21.02.2)
Reset to admin/admin reported working if reset button held down while switching on the device
Bestätigung: physisches Label v1.1, TP-Link-Firmware 2017-03-06 zeigte v1.0, Factory-Image 22.03.6 über die Stock-Weboberfläche installiert

TFTP.LAN Port to connect: LAN 1 works, probably any of LAN ports 1-4.
TFTP.Ablauf: Reset gedrückt halten, einschalten, 15 s halten oder bis TFTP-Übertragung; Router und PC direkt verbinden, nicht über Switch
TFTP.Debricking: Stock-Firmware als ArcherC2600_1.0_tp_recovery.bin, PC 192.168.0.66, Reset beim Einschalten ~15 s, Wiederherstellung ~5 min

Serial: Pinout: Blue - 1v8 Tx, Green - 1v8 Rx, Yellow - Vcc 1v8, Red - Vcc 3v3, Orange - GND
Use "Bi-Directional Logic Level Shifter Converter" to get 3v3 logic: 3v3 Tx - HV4, 3v3 Rx - HV3, GND - GND
Serial connection parameters for TP-Link Archer C2600 v1: 115200, 8N1
OEM bootlog (Auszug): SF: Detected MX25U25635F with page size 4 KiB, total 32 MiB
NAND:  ipq_nand: unknown NAND device manufacturer: 0 device: 0
Machine: Qualcomm Atheros AP148 reference board
Kernel command line: console=ttyHSL1,115200n8 root=mtd:rootfs rootfstype=squashfs
Notes: Known differences between Hardware v1.1 and v1.0: Flash chip used in v1.1 is changed (but same size). Possibly other changes...
Sporadic Reboots: cpufreq-Governor performance, max/min 1200000, cpuidle state0/1 abschalten (FS#3099, Forum 61999/17)
